lines.text: Many learners say: We were made wait for hours.
Better: We were made to wait for hours.
Make someone wait, but be made to wait.
To fill! She was made to fill the form again.

data.wrong: We were made wait for hours.
data.right: We were made to wait for hours.
data.why: Make someone wait, but be made to wait.
data.memory: made us WAIT, were made TO wait

quiz.stem: She was made ___ the form again.
